name: – Joachim Stanisław Brudziński – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section VII – Committee of the Regions
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the Committee of the Regions spent its 2023 budget. It also asks the Committee to do several things: explain a jump in interpreting costs, cut travel costs, do more to stop burnout, adopt an anti-fraud strategy, and set rules on conflicts of interest for members who leave. The report is mostly a set of opinions and requests; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament formally signs off the Committee of the Regions' 2023 spending.
- The Committee must report back on interpreting costs, staff competitions and anti-fraud plans.
- No law changes; the Committee decides whether to act on the requests.
